patterns.note: Split-screen hero section with a large, expressive serif headline on the left and a lifestyle image on the right, establishing a premium feel immediately.
Elegant, oversized serif typography for primary headings, creating a sophisticated and editorial feel, contrasted with clean sans-serif for body text and navigation.
A vibrant, bold red is used as a primary brand accent for the logo, key headings, and calls to action, standing out against a predominantly white and black content palette.
The main navigation bar becomes sticky at the top of the viewport after the initial scroll, replacing a smaller top information bar, and maintains its original size and background.
Product display grids feature distinct, pastel-colored packaging cards, providing visual variety while maintaining a clean, consistent layout.

technique_notes: A top information bar is initially visible, then on scroll, the main navigation bar smoothly transitions to a fixed sticky position at the top of the viewport, maintaining its full height and gaining a subtle shadow.
Content sections alternate between a large image on one side and descriptive text on the other, often with the image occupying a wider column, creating a dynamic visual rhythm down the page.
Prominent display serif headings are used to introduce sections, set in a large size and often in the brand's accent red, providing strong visual hierarchy and brand identity.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body text) with a strong contrast to functional sans-serif body and navigation text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on interactive elements like input fields and product cards.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with generous vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, creating a premium and uncrowded feel.

standout: The site's distinctive use of an elegant, oversized serif typeface for primary headings, combined with a bold brand red, elevates the aesthetic beyond typical e-commerce, creating a sophisticated and editorial brand presence that feels premium and approachable.
